backend/main.mo: Main actor for the chat backend implementing user registration, profile management, and messaging (text and image) with role-based access control and conversation participant validation.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades existing conversation messages to include an optional image field (set to null) when transitioning to the new schema.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—image attachment and emoji picker in MessageInput—to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document providing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files for build planning and documentation purposes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including sidebar, chart, and UI element color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ChatFlow app with PWA manifest, iOS meta tags, theme color, and a service worker registration script.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA Web App Manifest for ChatFlow defining app name, standalone display mode, teal theme color, and references to 192×192 and 512×512 PNG icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first strategy for the app shell while bypassing caching entirely for all ICP/Internet Identity API requests.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing the authentication and onboarding flow, rendering LoadingScreen, LoginPage, ProfileSetupModal, or MessagingLayout based on auth and profile state.
frontend/src/components/ChatHeader.tsx: Displays the chat header with the recipient's avatar, online status, username, and action buttons (search, call, video, more options).
frontend/src/components/ChatView.tsx: Renders the main chat area including grouped messages by date, an empty state placeholder, and an image modal; uses ChatHeader and MessageInput components.
frontend/src/components/ContactsList.tsx: Shows a searchable sidebar list of all user contacts (excluding the current user) with online status indicators and conversation selection handling.
frontend/src/components/EmojiPicker.tsx: A floating emoji picker with category tabs and search functionality that calls a callback when an emoji is selected and closes on outside clicks.
frontend/src/components/ImageModal.tsx: A fullscreen modal overlay for viewing an image with download and close (Escape key or button) controls.
frontend/src/components/ImagePreview.tsx: Displays a thumbnail preview of a selected image file with its name, size, and a button to remove it before sending.
frontend/src/components/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login/landing page with app branding, feature highlights, and an Internet Identity authentication button.
frontend/src/components/MessageInput.tsx: A chat message input component supporting text, emoji insertion, and image attachment, with send-on-Enter and optimistic state rollback on failure.
Top-level layout component that renders the contacts sidebar and chat view side by side, managing the active conversation state and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog for first-time users to set a username and status, calling the registerUser mutation and displaying validation errors.
A small presentational component that renders a colored dot indicating online or offline status.
frontend/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx: Renders a circular avatar with deterministic color and initials derived from a username, supporting multiple size variants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient, exposed through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for user profiles, online status, conversations, and messages, wrapping backend actor calls with caching and mutation logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Inter font, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a WhatsApp-inspired light/dark theme including chat-specific color tokens and scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/emojiData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and a large static dataset of emoji categories (e.g., Smileys & People) with emoji characters, names, and searchable keywords for use in an emoji picker.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support for sensitive values like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that maps oklch CSS variables to semantic color tokens (primary, sidebar, chat-sent, etc.), extends typography/animation plugins, and defines custom keyframes and box shadows for the chat UI.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking version, feature list, architectural notes, and known issues for a WhatsApp-like messaging PWA built on Internet Identity authentication.
